mapper.sql: (EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM student_job_application passed_application WHERE passed_application.student_id = su.id AND passed_application.status = 'interview_passed' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM internship_stage_assignment closed_stage WHERE closed_stage.application_id = passed_application.id AND closed_stage.status NOT IN ('PENDING_CONFIRMATION', 'CONFIRMED', 'IN_PROGRESS')) ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM interview_invitation passed_invitation WHERE passed_invitation.student_id = su.id AND passed_invitation.status = 'interview_passed' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM internship_confirmation_record closed_confirmation WHERE closed_confirmation.student_id = su.id AND closed_confirmation.position_id = passed_invitation.position_id AND (closed_confirmation.status = 2 OR closed_confirmation.recall_status = 2) AND closed_confirmation.update_time >= passed_invitation.update_time) ))
EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM internship_stage_assignment pending_stage WHERE pending_stage.student_id = su.id AND pending_stage.status = 'PENDING_CONFIRMATION' )

(EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM student_job_application opportunity_application WHERE opportunity_application.student_id = su.id AND opportunity_application.status IN ('pending', 'approved', 'interview', 'pending_interview') ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM interview_invitation opportunity_invitation WHERE opportunity_invitation.student_id = su.id AND opportunity_invitation.status IN ('pending', 'approved', 'interview', 'pending_interview') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM student_job_application ended_application WHERE ended_application.student_id = su.id AND ended_application.position_id = opportunity_invitation.position_id AND ended_application.status IN ('rejected', 'interview_failed', 'withdrawn', 'cancelled', 'canceled') AND ended_application.update_time >= opportunity_invitation.update_time) ))
COALESCE(( SELECT latest_status.status FROM student_internship_status latest_status WHERE latest_status.student_id = su.id ORDER BY latest_status.create_time DESC, latest_status.id DESC LIMIT 1 ), 0)
